notes: 2026-07-24: Created from scratch, merging all 30 rows from the founder-provided 'social_media_digital_marketing_agency_resources.csv' (Section II.40). Three of the CSV's 10 channels could not be matched to a real, confirmable YouTube channel: Noah's Ark Communications and Anakle (both real, well-documented Nigerian agencies with major-brand clients, but no confirmed dedicated channel — their Tumblr/website presence was their primary content hub), and Webcooks (could not be independently verified as a real entity this pass). Three independently-verified, directly on-topic replacements were substituted to reach 10 channels: Buffer, Techpoint Africa, and NairametricsTV.
